Class PDFReportGenerator

java.lang.Object
comp3607project.PDFReportGenerator
public class PDFReportGenerator extends Object
Creates a PDF report summarizing session metrics, event timeline information and error frequencies.

This documentation is generated from a separate copy of the submitted source. The original project source files are not modified.

      private void addSummaryPage(org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDDocument document, TelemetrySession session, int total, int successful, int failed, int errors, int executions, double average, long activeTime, long idleTime) throws IOException
      Adds a PDF page containing the session overview and calculated metrics.

      document - the PDF document being assembled
      session - the session metadata to include in the report

      executions - the executions value used by this operation
      average - the average value used by this operation
      activeTime - the active editing duration in milliseconds
      idleTime - the idle duration in milliseconds
      Throws:
      IOException - if the operation cannot be completed
